Russian Aerospace Forces (VKS) Mi-28N/NM and Ka-52/M attack helicopters are increasingly being used to intercept FP-1 and MICH-2000 drones, effectively serving as specialized drone hunters in rear areas alongside Tor-M2 and Pantsir-S1M air defense systems.
The Mi-28 uses its 30mm Shipunov 2A42 cannon for close-range engagements, supported by the OPS-28M multispectral electro-optical system and N025 mast-mounted radar, which can detect low-RCS targets at ranges of up to 5 km. Its automated fire-control system calculates lead angles to improve hit probability and reduce ammunition expenditure.
The Ka-52M has an advantage in poor weather, with its advanced Rezets active electronically scanned array (AESA) radar providing better resolution for detecting small drones against ground clutter than the Mi-28's N025 radar.
For longer-range engagements, both platforms can employ 9M342 Igla-S missiles and 9A1472 Vikhr-1 laser-beam-riding missiles, allowing them to engage targets beyond the effective range of the cannon.

U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) forces struck three Iranian crude oil tankers earlier today after the IRGC launched anti-ship ballistic missiles toward two U.S. Navy warships operating in regional waters.
The vessels disabled in the strikes were the M/T Downy near Kharg Island and the M/T Stark 1 near Jask. A third tanker, the M/T Kylo, also known as Noxen, was destroyed in the Gulf of Oman after its crew was ordered to abandon ship.

Earlier today, two explosions occurred at the General Maintenance Center of the RAM-2 “Bolívar” Mechanized Artillery Regiment in Viacha, La Paz Department, Bolivia.
The explosions were reported at around 2:30 PM in an area used to store pyrotechnic materials belonging to the Ministry of Defense.
At least two people were killed, 59 injured (including 52 civilians and 6 military personnel), and seven others remain missing.

Specialists from the Main Directorate of Intelligence of Ukraine’s Ministry of Defence (GUR/HUR) special unit “Group 13” struck a Russian K-300P Bastion-P coastal defense missile system in Crimea.
The Bastion-P can launch P-800 Oniks supersonic cruise missiles, which can engage both maritime and land targets, as well as 3M22 Zircon hypersonic missiles.
The “Group 13” operators also destroyed two fuel trucks and struck a command-and-staff vehicle belonging to Russian forces on the peninsula.
